notes: Conceptual coordinate mapping: centred building coordinates use +X east, +Z north and +Y up; the southwest/front approach is the negative-X/negative-Z side.

Articulated composition: a broad glazed social plinth supports a set-back upper sleeping bar and a deliberately open terrace; black roof/rails frame bright-yellow cladding and the red portal marks arrival.

Opening-host repair: the ground bath south wall now leaves x=-7.75..-6.25 for door-bath-gf; the panoramic living glazing has facade gap x=-7.35..-3.65; and display glazing has facade gap x=3.90..8.10. The entry and gaming glazing retain their existing clear facade gaps.

Opening-host repair: Bedroom 1 and Bedroom 2 now have added hall-partition wall segments around their repositioned 1.40 m openings at x=-5.50 and x=5.50 respectively; Bedroom 3 and Bedroom 4 divider gaps extend z=5.20..7.20; the upper bath west partition leaves z=0.50..1.90 around its moved opening at x=2.10. Upper west/east exterior glazing is clear of the shortened north wall segments.

Stair coordination repair: stair-main is a 2.60 m-wide, 4.20 m-run conceptual fourteen-riser flight from z=-2.20 to 2.00, terminating at the 3.00 m-wide landing z=2.00..3.00. The upper north bridge begins at z=3.00; terrace decking is split into west x=-8..-1 and east x=2..8 segments, preserving the x=-1..2 stair void without slab overlap.

Deterministic interval check executed against this proposed geometry in metres: ground-bath and upper-bath door clearances are 0.05 m; panoramic and display south-glazing clearances are 0.10 m; Bedroom 3/4 door clearances are 0.10 m. The stair void meets, without positive-volume overlap, the split terrace-deck edges; the flight meets the landing at z=2.00 and the landing meets the north bridge at z=3.00; the north bridge is 1.00 m beyond the flight termination. These are axis-aligned record/AABB

Basic deterministic record check: all 13 named program spaces are within coordinate bounds; 2 floors are indexed 0 and 1; procedural elements reference listed materials; spawn is at 1.95 m, about 1.7 m above the ground slab top, inside the entry and clear of the portal. Geometry has not been renderer-inspected.

Limitations: no plan, cutaway, rendered inspection, or walkthrough evidence was available for this proposal. The stated fourteen-riser arrangement is conceptual only; actual riser/tread geometry, handrails, headroom, structural support, fire/life safety, accessibility, egress, weatherproofing/drainage, glazing specification, and all code/regulatory compliance remain unverified.
